title: Release activation
source: lab/TARGETS.md section 6 row 10; P5 semantics in section 1.1; common basis with GS.11 in section 6.1 item 4
story: A new release changes 3 requirements; activation is a fact; the sweep re-reconciles 100k subjects at one pinned basis with live traffic.
checked: P5 bars (sweep <= 100 s, live p99 <= 1.5x); in-flight reconciles finish on the old release; every in-scope subject evaluated exactly once at the captured basis; subjects mutated after the basis was captured are swept as of the basis.
rungNote: At 10k the sweep scope is the 10,000 world subjects plus the 100 scenario subjects and the account; the wall-time bar is judged on the projection to 100k subjects at the measured rate. --sweep-cap limits the scope on slow lanes and then sweep-coverage-exact fails by design.

witnesses.positive: scenario subjects mutated after the basis was captured (they change in the live phase, but the sweep must show the captured basis)
witnesses.negative: scenario subjects that are swept but never written in the live phase

domain: R2 evaluated for every in-scope subject at R_act and published as work items through the outbox (O-DOMAIN)
faults: mutation of in-scope subjects after the basis is captured

oracle.source: O-REPLAY (state at the captured basis); O-DOMAIN (evaluation and work items)
gaps: work-item publication through the atomic outbox path is not built in the triplex-public composition (TARGETS 1.1 P5 item 3)
